module_summary: Round-robin arbiter: double-width subtract trick picks a grant from requests relative to a one-hot priority pointer, locks it until accept, then rotates priority.

anchors.name: prio_q
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin priority pointer, rotated past granted requester on accept.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector output, copy of gnt_q.

anchors.name: gnt_valid_o
anchors.why: Grant valid, copy of locked_q lock flag holding grant until accept.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Request vector feeding priority computation and lock set.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Accept releases lock, clears grant, rotates priority pointer.

anchors.name: dbl_gnt
anchors.why: Double-width masked priority result folded into next grant gnt_d.

groups.name: rr_priority_logic
groups.description: Double-width priority search from prio_q pointer producing registered grant.

groups.name: grant_lock
groups.description: Lock flag holding grant from request until accept handshake.
